scenario_title: Suspected septic arthritis with bloodstream infection

requesting_team.coverage_note: Requesting resident remains in the ED until 23:00 local time. Call the ED attending after that time.

consult_request.decision_needed: Recommend empiric antimicrobial coverage and diagnostic next steps for suspected native-knee septic arthritis with preliminary gram-positive cocci in blood cultures.
consult_request.reason_now: The patient has a purulent knee aspirate, rising inflammatory markers, and a preliminary positive blood culture. Orthopedics is planning operative washout tonight.
specific_questions: Is the current empiric regimen appropriate before organism identification and susceptibilities return?
Which operative specimens and additional cultures should be obtained?
What findings would change the anticipated antimicrobial duration?
consultant_action_requested: Review current microbiology and antimicrobial selection
consult_request.accept_or_redirect_context: Orthopedics has accepted the patient for source control but requests Infectious Diseases management of suspected bacteremia and antimicrobial planning.

chief_complaint: Fever and rapidly worsening left knee pain

symptoms.details: Rapidly progressive swelling; unable to bear weight since this morning
Maximum home temperature reported as 39.1 C

pertinent_negatives: No recent surgery or prosthetic joint
No cough, dysuria, or focal skin abscess

conditions: Type 2 diabetes mellitus; most recent documented A1c 8.4%
Remote left-knee meniscal repair in 2012; no implanted hardware
home_medications: Metformin extended release 1000 mg by mouth twice daily
recent_exposures: Small abrasion over left shin after gardening 8 days ago

physical_exam.cardiopulmonary: Tachycardic, regular rhythm; lungs clear; no respiratory distress
physical_exam.left_knee: Large effusion, warmth, diffuse tenderness, and severe pain with passive range of motion; no draining wound
physical_exam.skin: Healing 1.5 cm superficial abrasion on left anterior shin without fluctuance
physical_exam.neurologic: Sensation and distal motor function intact in the left foot

synovial_fluid.gram_stain: Many polymorphonuclear cells; gram-positive cocci in clusters reported

microbiology.preliminary_result: One of four bottles flagged positive with gram-positive cocci in clusters at 17:38

imaging.left_knee_xray: Large joint effusion; no acute fracture; no radiopaque foreign body

ed_treatment_and_actions.action: Vancomycin 1750 mg intravenous loading dose started after cultures
Orthopedic Surgery evaluated patient and tentatively scheduled operative washout for 21:00
Patient made NPO; repeat renal function ordered

ownership_and_next_steps.next_action: Infectious Diseases review of empiric therapy and operative specimen plan
ownership_and_next_steps.escalation_trigger: Notify ED attending immediately for systolic blood pressure below 90 mm Hg, lactate increase, altered mental status, or new oxygen requirement

intended_workflow_challenges: Urgent consultation with a focused question and reliable callback
Several teams share responsibility but have different next actions
Important microbiology and operative evidence is still pending
The consultant must preserve a provisional plan rather than mark the case complete
high_signal_facts: Purulent inflammatory synovial fluid with gram-positive cocci
Preliminary blood culture with gram-positive cocci in clusters
Acute kidney injury may affect antimicrobial planning
intentional_uncertainties: Organism identification and susceptibilities are not yet known
Final operative timing and findings are not yet known
Duration of therapy cannot yet be finalized
